notes:
The benchmark's checks find rows by display names (account, product, SLA name, the case's short description); the requirements use the keys these resolve to on the seed: account 7, product 1, SLA definition 2, and the new case 1233.
'Next year' is read as 2026, as the benchmark reads it; the seed fixes no current date.
The case's path from new to in_progress cannot be seen in the final state, so only the final state is tested.
The check on the entitlement's link to the 2026 contract tests cells the contract and entitlement requirements already carry, so both list it.
The request asks for the case to show work has started but assigns no group or user; the policy sets in_progress for an assigned case, so the request's explicit wording decides the state.
'Reachable' is not testable on the contact row, which has no phone or email column.
The request does not ask for the resolution SLA, so only the response SLA is required; no listed tool creates interactions, though the policy requires one per new case.

disagreement: value: the contact's account_id: one pass tests account 7, the other leaves it untested; kept it because the contact used must be Wayne Enterprises' own.
disagreement: value: the interaction row: one pass selects it by case, the other anchors it on interaction_id 1233; chose the anchor because the task registers exactly one interaction.
disagreement: value: the SLA link row: one pass selects it by case and SLA definition, the other anchors it on case_sla_id 2465; chose the anchor because the request attaches exactly one SLA to the case.
